Historical Steam game prices and player reviews

Source: R/data.R
steam_games.Rd

A prepared data set of 27,075 games. Each row represents one game, identified by appid. Games can have several genre labels.

Usage

steam_games

Format

A data frame with 27,075 rows and 9 variables:

appid

Unique Steam application identifier.

name

Game title.

release_date

Game release date, stored as a Date.

genres

Genre labels separated by semicolons.

price

Historical list price in GBP; zero denotes a free game.

positive_ratings

Number of positive reviews in the snapshot.

negative_ratings

Number of negative reviews in the snapshot.

total_reviews

Positive plus negative review counts.

positive_percent

Positive reviews divided by total reviews, multiplied by 100.

Source

Tuvshin Selenge, Steam_games, Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7904761. Original price-cleaning methodology: https://nik-davis.github.io/posts/2019/steam-data-cleaning/.

Details

Release dates range from 1997-06-30 to 2019-05-01. Review counts and prices are historical, not current Steam listings. The positive percentage is a simple derived proportion, not a reconstruction of Steam's official review classification.

Examples

utils::head(steam_games, 3)
#>   appid                  name release_date genres price positive_ratings
#> 1    10        Counter-Strike   2000-11-01 Action  7.19           124534
#> 2    20 Team Fortress Classic   1999-04-01 Action  3.99             3318
#> 3    30         Day of Defeat   2003-05-01 Action  3.99             3416
#>   negative_ratings total_reviews positive_percent
#> 1             3339        127873         97.38882
#> 2              633          3951         83.97874
#> 3              398          3814         89.56476
